text:
Maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — consolidating action items for GPU headroom + autoscale. Need clear owners and dates so we can close these by EOW next week.
Sam: I can own scheduler tuning. Plan: 1) tighten pod packing policy, 2) test burst headroom, 3) adjust cooldowns. Target: 2026-04-02.
Li: I'll take quota requests with finance & cloud team. Filing PR to request +20% reserved quota for prod pools. ETA: 2026-03-30.
Olivia: I'll own the headroom runbook edits and the on-call playbook changes (what to do during surge). Will add checklist items for rollback. Doing first pass today.
Sam: Quick config I want to try in staging:
```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metrics:
  - type: Pods
    pods:
      metric:
        name: gpu_utilization
      target:
        type: AverageValue
        averageValue: "75"
behavior:
  scaleDown:
    stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300
```
Sam: This raises the stabilization window to avoid oscillation during short spikes.
Maya: Nice. Add a canary on the lowest-traffic shard for 24h, then promote.
Li: capacity-bot created ticket https://redwood.local/tickets/INC-4382 for quota request, cc @finance.
capacity-bot: Reminder: quota request INC-4382 created by Li; current status: awaiting approval. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Olivia: Also found 2 recurring patterns in alerts: 1) sudden burst from embeddings jobs at midnight, 2) warmup latency when new models spin up. I'll put examples in the doc.
Maya: For embeddings bursts, can we gate large batch jobs to non-peak windows? @Sam @Li need input on whether to enforce in scheduler or via job owner policy.
Sam: Prefer policy at job level (scheduling constraints) + scheduler throttling as fallback. I'll draft policy.
Li: If job-level gating isn't adopted quickly, I'll bump the quota temporarily to avoid customer impact.
Olivia: Can we add a small metric to Console: headroom ratio per pool (free_gpus / reserved_gpus) so SRE/owners can see tight pools?
Sam: Yep, I can add metric. Will instrument in next deploy (2026-03-29).
Maya: Owners & dates recap: Sam - scheduler tuning & metric (2026-03-29 / 2026-04-02 deploys), Li - quota request (2026-03-30), Olivia - runbook + examples (2026-03-27). I'll update the postmortem doc and send calendar invites for a 15m closure check on 2026-04-03.
Olivia: I'll start a weekly 10m sync for the remediation owners to track regressions.
Sam: Adding one follow-up: run a 48h headroom simulation during low traffic to validate autoscaler settings. ETA to schedule: 2026-03-31.
Maya: Perfect. Please put any blockers in this thread. Otherwise :thumbsup: and I'll mark these in the action tracker.
Li: :thumbsup: filing a note to finance now.
capacity-bot: Action tracker updated: INC-4382, TASK-9123 (scheduler canary), TASK-9124 (runbook), TASK-9125 (headroom sim).
Maya: Closing loop — if we see repeating spikes after these items, we escalate to capacity oncall and consider temporary reserved bumps. Thanks all.
